shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,300p' .lore/dod.md && printf '\\n--- test commands ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && printf '\\n--- git ---\\n' && git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"postalCode|describe\\(|it\\(|test\\(\" src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && rg -n \"lore-query-trace|tests_covering\" .lore package.json scripts || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
sed -n '1,240p' src/types/ai.ts
sed -n '1,220p' package.json
sed -n '1,220p' jest.config.* 2>/dev/null || true
rg -n \"ToolRegistry|inputSchema\" src/orchestration -g '*test.ts' | head -160"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -C 4 \"FAIL|●|Expected|Coverage|error TS|registry\\.test\" ../round-brief.md && git log --oneline -5 && git status --short && git show --stat --oneline HEAD"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs "src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts::ToolRegistry validates a function definition against the schema resolved for each call"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git status --short'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "test: fix dynamic tool schema fixture" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
